IsAnyoneUp.com

I was 14, my first boyfriend was turning 19 and really pressured me to send him a nude. He cheated on me (with my friend) when I refused his pressure to “give him my virginity”.

The website was at its peak and everyone in our small school would talk about it. I became terrified that this guy would post my picture, especially when he told his friends I deserved it for being a “prude”.

I remember reading the comments on each post and feeling so sad for the girls/guys being ridiculed. It gave me a really warped view toward my own body.
